description:
Huge Thanks to our friend Ahmed from Hatay. Please support him and follow him on his YouTube channel and Instagram: @hardmaniver 

After an unforgettable journey, we eventually left Syria and made our way to Istanbul, our final stop along the ancient Silk Road. On the way, we passed through Antakya, a place that felt deeply surreal. I had visited just three years earlier, shortly before the devastating earthquake. Today, much of the city still lies in ruins, yet signs of hope are everywhere. New homes are being built, and construction workers told us that many residents may be able to move into their houses within the next two months. For now, however, most people continue to live in large container villages as the rebuilding process continues.
